author: Boston Dynamics
description:
Why will Boston Dynamics win the humanoid robotics race? We've already commercialized autonomous mobile robots, creating markets with Spot and Stretch. Now we're doing it again with Atlas: learning in real environments, designing for manufacturing at scale, and introducing a new era of physical intelligence.

Learn more RMAC: https://bostondynamics.com/news/boston-dynamics-opens-robotics-metaplant-application-center-to-train-humanoid-robots-for-manufacturing-tasks/
Learn more about Atlas: https://bostondynamics.com/products/atlas/
title: Inside the Robotics Race | Boston Dynamics x Hyundai Motor Group x Bloomberg Media Studios
